name: Poisoned Dart Trap (1-2)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future

disable: DC 20 Thievery check (trained) to disable the pressure plate
reset: The trap resets after 2 rounds. After 5 total attacks, it runs out of poisoned darts.

items.name: Dart Volley
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps on the pressure plate

---

Effect A poisoned dart shoots at the triggering creature.

items.name: Giant Centipede Venom
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 17 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d6 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 2 1d8 poison damage and Off-Guard (1 round)

Stage 3 1d12 poison damage, Clumsy 1, and off-guard (1 round)

text: Poisoned darts fire from recesses in the walls when a creature steps on a pressure plate.
